instructions.primary_message: Add eggs to blender and blend for about 30 seconds. Add the butter to a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until melted. Continue to stir the mixture as it foams up and when the foam subsides, and a brown butter appears, remove from the heat.

Add browned butter, milk, 1/2 cup water, flour, sugar, and vanilla to the blender and pulse until well blended (30 seconds). Scrape down the sides of the blender with a scraper and pulse to blend for about 10 seconds more. Stir in lemon zest.

Start heating a nonstick crêpe pan over medium heat and brush pan with avocado oil. Pour 1/3 cup of the batter into the center of pan. Tilt the pan to spread the batter evenly to make a circle. Cook until the underside is browned (about 45 seconds). Flip the crêpe over and cook until browned on the bottom. Repeat with remaining avocado oil and batter. Store crêpes covered in the refrigerator until ready to assemble.

Heat the nonstick crêpe pan over medium heat. Place one crêpe on the pan and sprinkle about 3 tablespoons of the Gruyère over the crêpe and lay about 2 ounces of ham on one half of the crêpe. When cheese is nicely melted, fold the crêpe over the ham and place on serving plate. Repeat with remaining crêpes, cheese and ham.
Serve with avocado slices and fresh fruit if desired.
